name: ship-tasks
description: Deliver selected Task Manager work with durable acceptance reporting and problem-first strategic explanations.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver work with visible acceptance incidents.
interface.longDescription: Includes two sibling skills. Ship Tasks delivers work through explicit $ship-tasks or natural language that names an existing Task or selected Task Manager scope. A delivery verb alone does not activate it. Its requirements act as a constitution: sufficient evidence, truthful state, readable native comments, visible acceptance incidents, and authority boundaries are mandatory while planning, tools, delegation, context shape, diagnostics, and acceptance methods remain agent choices. Native comments are part of the Task Manager adapter contract. Strategic Explainer turns established facts into a grounded problem-first human explanation without taking status, authority, or execution decisions and without requiring a specific agent topology or prompt envelope.
defaultPrompt: Deliver TM-123 to a verified terminal outcome
Create exactly one Task in Task Manager and immediately start delivering it
Use Strategic Explainer with an explicit problem to find strategic context and explain the current result
